items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launches, public beta, security-sensitive releases, and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: technical compliance baseline is 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; revenue is limited to $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, keep searchwoot.com private and preview-only, and keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, and preview-only. Do not admit new queue work, requeue failures, deploy, add dependencies, expand telemetry, spend, or conduct external outreach. Next evidence action: attach one dated consolidated evidence bundle covering rights, data flow and retention, consent/GA4, logs/vendors/incidents, accuracy/freshness, rollback, and owner disposition.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts show progress but do not close any task. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Review progress only from direct evidence; do not close tasks on inference.

SearchWoot data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked because rights to fetch, store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize the data are not evidenced and public terms restrict relevant uses. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and use limits, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce a read-only data-flow and retention table including identifiers, deletion/correction/access, Slack delivery, consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, property and data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory and route unresolved gaps to human counsel.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence do not support a go-live proposal. Ordinary growth need not be blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, but any change must preserve existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Parked sites require dated owner, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker packets before reconsideration.
